svg.aria-label: Dumbbell bench press, Top: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and both dumbbells above your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell bench press, Top: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and both dumbbells above your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell bench press, Lower: Bend both elbows to lower the dumbbells evenly toward the sides of your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell bench press, Lower: Bend both elbows to lower the dumbbells evenly toward the sides of your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell bench press, Bottom: Pause beside your chest with your wrists above your elbows and your upper arms angled away from your ribs.
svg.title: Dumbbell bench press, Bottom: Pause beside your chest with your wrists above your elbows and your upper arms angled away from your ribs.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell bench press, Press: Press both dumbbells back up under control.
svg.title: Dumbbell bench press, Press: Press both dumbbells back up under control.
